extension.summary: Your RSS and Atom feeds as Windows Phone style live tiles
extension.description: A hub of flat, coloured live tiles built from your RSS and Atom feeds. Tiles flip, peek and roll to show new stories; pictures come from the feeds themselves. Five layouts (Feed groups, Mixed wall, Magazine, Spotlight, Mosaic), three tile styles (Classic, Modern, Outline), twenty accent colours plus your own, per-feed accents, and Day / Night themes switched by hand, by the clock or at sunrise and sunset. Select a tile to expand it into the full story with a QR code for your phone; podcasts and video enclosures play straight away. Feeds are managed in the program (add, edit, reorder, OPML import and export) and refresh in the background; everything works offline from the cache.
